name: Benefits — PAR independent lab: apply the coinsurance
description: Twenty guided steps built from the Benefits.2 story: price the line, work through the 5Ws of Benefit (the provider's specialty and participation, the procedure, the date of service, the claim type and place of service, the diagnosis) with Code Set lookups, find the Testing Services → Professional → Lab service-level benefit for the PAR provider, check the out-of-pocket limits and the accumulators, calculate the coinsurance the member owes, validate to apply the benefits and confirm them on Claim Lines, then pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure
steps.description: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure. Open the Search tab, then the Pricing sub-tab, scroll down to the Claim lines section and click Get Pricing. The allowed amount then shows in the Allowed column. Review it together with the Billed amount (the bill charge) and the Write-off: the allowed amount is the bill charge less the write-off. For procedure 81479 the bill charge is $400.00, the allowed amount is $250.00 and the write-off is $150.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Get Pricing is clicked in Search → Pricing.
steps.hint: Search tab → Pricing sub-tab → Claim lines → Get Pricing. Allowed = Billed − Write-off.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure

steps.name: Who — check the provider specialty
steps.description: Start the 5Ws of Benefit, which decide the right benefit for the claim. The first W is Who. Open the Provider Info tab and, in the Rendering section, read the Speciality and Speciality description fields: the provider's specialty is INDEPENDENT LABORATORY (069).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Provider Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Provider Info → Rendering → Speciality and Speciality description: 069 - INDEPENDENT LABORATORY.

steps.name: Who — confirm provider participation
steps.description: Continue the Who review on the Claim Header tab. In the General Claim Data section, the Provider Participation field reads PAR: the provider participates in the network, so the PAR benefits apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Header → General Claim Data → Provider Participation: PAR.

steps.name: What — identify the procedure code
steps.description: The next W is What. Open the Claim Lines tab and find the procedure code on line 1: 81479. You look it up in Code Set next.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Procedure: 81479.

steps.name: What — review the procedure code details
steps.description: Look up the procedure code. Open the Search tab, then the Code Set sub-tab. Procedure Code (Px) is already selected in Select Code Type and 81479 is in Enter Code, with the search already performed. Note the description — UNLISTED MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY PROCEDURE — and the service classes CA5, SU3 (SUTTER GENETIC TEST), VA1 (VA HMO LAB CORP), 20A (LAB), 20I (SOS LAB PROC), 39 (NY BUNDLE CODE), 99S (SUTTER AUTH WAIVED) and 99Z (HMO OFFICE SERVICE). Together they tell you the service billed: a laboratory test, an unlisted molecular pathology procedure.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Code Set sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Search tab → Code Set sub-tab. The 81479 lookup is already shown.
steps.checklistItem: What — review the procedure code details

steps.name: When — note the date of service
steps.description: The next W is When. Go back to the Claim Lines tab and read the date of service on line 1 from its From date and To columns: 01/15/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → From date and To: 01/15/2026.
steps.checklistItem: When — note the date of service

steps.name: Where — check the claim type
steps.description: The next W is Where: where the service was performed. Start with the claim type. Open the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and in the Additional Claim Data section read the Claim type field: PA - Professional.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Data → Details sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Data → Details → Additional Claim Data → Claim type: PA - Professional.

steps.name: Where — note the place of service
steps.description: Check the place of service on the claim. On the Claim Lines tab, the POS field on line 1 reads 81.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → POS: 81.
steps.checklistItem: Where — note the place of service

steps.name: Where — confirm the POS description
steps.description: Look up the POS code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Place of Service (POS) in Select Code Type. Line 1's code, 81, fills in and its result shows straight away: the description is INDEPENDENT LAB.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the POS 81 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Place of Service (POS), or by searching that type for 81.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Place of Service (POS). POS 81 is INDEPENDENT LAB.

steps.name: Why — identify the diagnosis code
steps.description: The final W is Why. On the Claim Lines tab, find the diagnosis code on line 1: Z940.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Diagnosis: Z940.

steps.name: Why — review the diagnosis code details
steps.description: Look up the diagnosis code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10) in Select Code Type. Line 1's diagnosis, Z940, fills in and the search is applied: the description is KIDNEY TRANSPLANT STATUS and the limit class is 055 - EXEMPT DX FOR POA.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Z940 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10), or by searching that type for Z940.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10).
steps.checklistItem: Why — review the diagnosis code details

steps.name: Open the benefits for the contract
steps.description: With the 5Ws complete — an independent laboratory that is PAR, procedure 81479 on 01/15/2026, a PA - Professional claim at POS 81 (INDEPENDENT LAB), diagnosis Z940 — check the benefits that apply. Open the Search tab, then the Benefits sub-tab, and make sure the date of service, 01/15/2026, falls inside the contract's Effective date and End date (01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Benefits sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Search tab → Benefits sub-tab. 01/15/2026 falls inside 01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999.
steps.checklistItem: Open the benefits for the contract

steps.name: Locate the benefit category and subcategory
steps.description: Click + next to Service level to open the benefit categories, listed under a Benefits Category search box. Open the Benefit Hierarchy Service Categories Document to identify the Major Category and subcategory to select as per the Procedure details previously identified. From the procedure details you noted, the major category is Testing Services and the subcategory is Professional - Lab: the claim type is PA - Professional, so the subcategory sits under Professional, not Facility. Expand Testing Services with its arrow to show its subcategories, Facility and Professional, then expand Professional to show the categories beneath it: Diagnostic Imaging, Infertility, Lab, Maternity, Other Studies, Pathology, Pre-Admit Testing and Routine. Lab is the category for this procedure, and it has no further categories beneath it to check, so Professional - Lab is the benefit to use.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Professional is expanded under Testing Services. Expanding Testing Services alone, Facility or any other category completes nothing.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Service level → expand Testing Services → expand Professional (not Facility). Lab is the subcategory.
steps.checklistItem: Locate the benefit category and subcategory

steps.name: Review the Professional - Lab benefits for the PAR provider
steps.description: Click View Benefits on the Lab row beneath Professional. A dialog titled Service level opens with the heading LAB and lists the place-of-service options. The POS is 81, INDEPENDENT LAB, and the INDEPENDENT LAB entry has two options, both TIER - 1. Open each option's triangle and use the Network column to tell them apart: the option showing PAR is the benefit for this PAR provider. It shows an individual deductible of $1,500.00 (PINDED), a family deductible of $3,000.00 (PFMDED), coinsurance of 70.00%, and Y for the deductibles and coinsurance included in OOP, the adjudication indicator and the benefit covered indicator. The other option shows NPAR, with a $2,000.00 individual deductible, a $3,500.00 family deductible and 60.00% coinsurance. So the member pays the $1,500.00 individual or the $3,000.00 family deductible, whichever applies; once it is satisfied, the plan pays 70% of the allowed amount and the member pays 30% as coinsurance. Close the dialog.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the option whose Network column reads PAR is opened. The NPAR option and the other options complete nothing.
steps.hint: View Benefits on Lab (under Testing Services → Professional) → open both INDEPENDENT LAB options → the one showing PAR is the benefit.
steps.checklistItem: Review the Professional - Lab benefits for the PAR provider

steps.name: Review the Out-of-Pocket limits
steps.description: Click + next to Plan Level on the same Benefits sub-tab, then scroll to the Out-of-pocket table to check the out-of-pocket limits for this service. The provider is PAR, so read only the PAR rows: the individual OOP limit is $3,000.00 and the family OOP limit is $6,000.00 (the NPAR limits are $5,500.00 and $11,000.00). You already reviewed the deductible limits under the service-level benefit, so they need no second look.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Plan Level is opened.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Plan Level → Out-of-pocket: PAR $3,000.00 individual, $6,000.00 family.

steps.name: Review the accrued deductible
steps.description: Now check how much of the deductible and OOP limits the member has already accrued. In the Accumulators section of the same sub-tab, open the DEDUCTIBLE group. For the benefit year 01/01/2026 – 12/31/2026 it shows INDIVIDUAL DED PAR 1500.00, INDIVIDUAL DED NONPAR 1120.00, FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE PAR 2650.00 and FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE NONPAR 2010.00. The provider is PAR, so only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the DEDUCTIBLE accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → DEDUCTIBLE. PAR: individual 1500.00, family 2650.00.

steps.name: Review the accrued Out-of-Pocket
steps.description: Open the OUT OF POCKET group in the Accumulators section. For the same period it shows INDIVIDUAL OOP PAR 2400.00, INDIVIDUAL OOP NONPAR 1780.00, FAMILY OOP PAR 4200.00 and FAMILY OOP NONPAR 3250.00. Again, only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the OUT OF POCKET accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → OUT OF POCKET. PAR: individual 2400.00, family 4200.00.

steps.name: Calculate the benefits to apply
steps.description: Summarise what you found and work out the benefits for line 1, then open the Claim Lines tab, where they will be applied. Claim: bill charge $400.00, allowed $250.00, write-off $150.00. Benefits: individual deductible $1,500.00, family deductible $3,000.00, coinsurance 70%. OOP limits: individual $3,000.00, family $6,000.00. Accrued: individual deductible 1500.00, family deductible 2650.00, individual OOP 2400.00, family OOP 4200.00. Remaining deductible: individual $1,500.00 − 1500.00 = $0.00; family $3,000.00 − 2650.00 = $350.00. Remaining OOP: individual $3,000.00 − 2400.00 = $600.00; family $6,000.00 − 4200.00 = $1,800.00. The member has already met the individual deductible, so no deductible applies: the plan pays 70% of the allowed amount and the member pays 30% as coinsurance — 30% of $250.00 = $75.00, within the $600.00 of individual OOP still remaining — leaving $175.00 ($250.00 − $75.00) to pay on this claim. Only the write-off and the coinsurance change on line 1, each with its EOB code: PX_00066 for the $150.00 write-off and PX_00067 for the $75.00 coinsurance.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: The individual deductible is met ($1,500.00 − 1500.00 = $0.00), so the member pays 30% coinsurance: 30% of $250.00 = $75.00, and $175.00 is paid. EOB PX_00066 for the write-off, PX_00067 for the coinsurance.

steps.name: Validate and confirm the applied benefits
steps.description: With the amounts worked out, click Validate on the claim summary bar: the strip showing Billed, Allowed and Paid beneath the header, not the Claim Header tab. The system then applies the benefits to the claim automatically, and the values change on the Claim Lines tab you are already on. Check that the amounts and EOB codes Validate applied match your calculation: Line 1 — Benefits now shows EOB PX_00066 with a write-off of $150.00, EOB PX_00067 with coinsurance of $75.00, $175.00 paid, and the Benefit rule PROFLAB - PROFLB. These values appear only after Validate.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is clicked on the claim summary bar.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Then read Line 1 — Benefits on the Claim Lines tab.
steps.completionToast: Benefits applied to line 1 — coinsurance and write-off posted.
steps.checklistItem: Validate and confirm the applied amounts and EOB codes

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Once the benefits are applied and confirmed, pay the claim. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
